query:
-- Vue unifiée pour toutes les liaisons molécules
-- Préserve 100% des données existantes tout en simplifiant les requêtes

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW molecule_links_unified AS

-- Liaisons Molécules <-> Accords
SELECT 
  NULL as id,
  ma.moleculeId as molecule_id,
  'accord' as link_type,
  ma.accordId as target_id,
  a.name as target_name,
  NULL as metadata,
  NULL as created_at
FROM molecule_accords ma
JOIN accords a ON a.id = ma.accordId

UNION ALL

-- Liaisons Molécules <-> Familles Olfactives
SELECT 
  NULL as id,
  mf.moleculeId as molecule_id,
  'family' as link_type,
  mf.familyId as target_id,
  f.name as target_name,
  NULL as metadata,
  NULL as created_at
FROM molecule_families mf
JOIN families f ON f.id = mf.familyId

UNION ALL

-- Liaisons Molécules <-> Familles Chimiques
SELECT 
  NULL as id,
  mcf.moleculeId as molecule_id,
  'chemical_family' as link_type,
  mcf.chemicalFamilyId as target_id,
  cf.name as target_name,
  NULL as metadata,
  NULL as created_at
FROM molecule_chemical_families mcf
JOIN chemical_families cf ON cf.id = mcf.chemicalFamilyId

UNION ALL

-- Liaisons Molécules <-> Origines Géographiques
SELECT 
  mo.id as id,
  mo.molecule_id as molecule_id,
  'origin' as link_type,
  mo.origin_id as target_id,
  go.name as target_name,
  JSON_OBJECT(
    'isPrimary', mo.is_primary_origin,
    'qualityRating', mo.quality_rating,
    'productionVolume', mo.production_volume,
    'priceRange', mo.price_range
  ) as metadata,
  mo.created_at as created_at
FROM molecule_origins mo
JOIN geographic_origins go ON go.id = mo.origin_id

UNION ALL

-- Liaisons Molécules <-> Plantes Sources
SELECT 
  mps.id as id,
  mps.molecule_id as molecule_id,
  'plant_source' as link_type,
  mps.plant_id as target_id,
  p.name as target_name,
  JSON_OBJECT(
    'plantPart', mps.plant_part,
    'percentageInPlant', mps.percentage_in_plant,
    'percentageInOil', mps.percentage_in_oil,
    'variability', mps.variability
  ) as metadata,
  mps.created_at as created_at
FROM molecule_plant_sources mps
JOIN plants p ON p.id = mps.plant_id;
